transfer_definition.bounded_supports: on every recorded trajectory (SP8, DXp, DXn), before acting at step t and for each action b: the projection of the next code after b over every complete Moore machine with <= n states (start state 0) consistent with the evidence so far, brute.region.RegionSpace(n).predict_support(b) (tri-state: UNKNOWN codes count as possible; status != supported -> None), with its unknown count. Recorded for n in {2, 3, 4, 5} on the SP8 trajectory and for n in {4, min(n_L + 1, 4), n_L + 1 if <= 5} on each DX trajectory. Learner-visible (no hidden state).
transfer_definition.RG_arm: RGn post hoc on a trajectory: at step t for action b, the SP8 certificate if any; else, if t > burn_in, the SP8 published support for b is not None and bounded_support[n][b] == (c,) with c in that support, certify c (rule 'rg'). RG4 (n = FB) is the gated library-free baseline; RG2, RG3, RG5 are reported.
transfer_definition.DLF_arm: the v0.12.0 bounded transfer license, post hoc on a trajectory with library L (frozen TransferTracker filtered by that trajectory's own observations): the SP8 certificate if any (rule 'sp8'); else if t > burn_in and the SP8 published support S for b is not None: (1) if bounded_support[FB][b] == (c,) with c in S: certify c (rule 'rg'); (2) else if L is alive and predicts the unanimous code c for b, c in S, and bounded_support[min(n_L + margin, FB)][b] == (c,): certify c (rule 'license'); else UNKNOWN. margin = 1. DLF0 (margin 0) is a reported sensitivity arm. Exact: DLF certificates contain RG4 certificates, which contain SP8 certificates.
transfer_definition.AT_arm: the frozen v0.11.0 AT rule (experiments.brute_study_013.gated_arm mode 'AT', M = 6) on the SP8 trace: a reported control (ATp / ATn) and the stress-pair selector.
transfer_definition.DX_arm: a new SP8 trajectory on the same target world, seed and mask whose actions are chosen by the frozen v0.11.0 LX rule (experiments.brute_study_013.lx_trajectory imported unchanged: lx-split over the surviving library hypotheses, else lx-plan by the SP8 lookahead value, else the SP8 action); certified post hoc by DLF with the same library on its own trajectory and its own bounded supports. DXp / DXn: positive / wrong-family library.
transfer_definition.stress_block: aliasing stress: for every target case and every WRONG-family library (3 other families x 24 offsets = 72 libraries, sources 7150001-7150096), AT6 and DLF are run post hoc on the SP8 trace with that library (bounded supports of the SP8 trajectory). A stress pair is a (case, library) pair where AT6 issues >= 1 transfer certificate. Per pair the runner records n_L, AT6 false / transfer counts, DLF false / license / rg counts and DLF0 false.
transfer_definition.speedup: S(case, X) = T_cert(SP8) - T_cert(X) on the taken action, censored at 45 (T_cert = first step 1..44 whose taken-action certificate is not None, else 45); for DX, T_cert is on the DX trajectory. Transfer value TV(case, X) = S(case, X) - S(case, RG4).

api_definition.file: brute/api/certify2.py (new; brute/api/certify.py and every other brute/api file untouched)
api_definition.interface: Certifier2(library=None, margin=1): library is None or {'hypotheses': H (brute.transfer.expand output), 'min_n': n_L}. .initialize(observation) ; .observe(action, observation) ; .query(action) -> {'api': 'brute.certify/2', 'status': 'CERTIFIED' | 'UNKNOWN', 'answer': int | None, 'support': list | None, 'bounded_support': list | None, 'rule': 'sp8' | 'rg' | 'license' | None, 'reason': None if CERTIFIED else one of REASONS, 'step': int}. REASONS = ('burn-in', 'sp8-support-unavailable', 'region-not-singleton', 'outside-sp8-support', 'library-refuted', 'library-split', 'bounded-region-not-singleton', 'no-library'). The reason is the FIRST failing condition in DLF order. certify2(observations, actions, query_action, library=None) is the stateless wrapper. margin must be 1 (ValueError otherwise; margin 0 is unsound under stress). Family: deterministic Moore, <= 4 states, stationary, 2 actions, 2 bits, attested by the caller. No host, I/O, network, threads, subprocesses or global state.
api_definition.gate_test: tests/test_api_certify2_0120.py: (i) without a library, on the 4 api_test trajectories (smoke seeds 7190009-7190012, mask 0.35) Certifier2 returns CERTIFIED with the same code exactly where RG4 certifies for both actions at every step, and every brute.certify/1 certificate is a Certifier2 certificate; (ii) with the positive smoke library it returns exactly the DLF decision of experiments/brute_study_014 on the same trajectory (status, answer, rule) for both actions at every step; (iii) every UNKNOWN carries a reason in REASONS; (iv) malformed input and margin != 1 raise ValueError; (v) the module imports no host-specific module (AST: no os, subprocess, socket, http, threading, open()).

watchdog_definition.changes: (1) heartbeat lines are appended with a plain buffered write and flush, no per-beat fsync; a background thread calls os.fsync on the heartbeat file every 30 s; (2) the deadline/kill logic runs in its own thread that does no disk I/O before the kill (it sleeps on CLOCK_MONOTONIC until RUN_T0 + 7200 s, then SIGTERM / SIGKILL every process group in an in-memory copy of RUN_STATE refreshed by the main thread); (3) every beat records wall, CLOCK_MONOTONIC, CLOCK_BOOTTIME, the process CPU time, and the /proc/pressure/io some/full totals, so a gap can be attributed (descheduled host: BOOTTIME and MONOTONIC both advance, CPU time flat, PSI flat; I/O stall: PSI full total advances). Beat interval 2 s as study-013.

second_implementation.method: Bounded supports by exhaustive enumeration: for n states, every complete transition table d: (state, action) -> state with start state 0 (n^(2n) tables; 5^10 = 9,765,625 for n = 5) is simulated along the recorded actions with numpy; per table the set of codes still allowed at each state is the AND of the observation masks seen there (unvisited states allow all 4 codes); a table is feasible iff no state's set is empty; the projection for action b is the OR over feasible tables of the allowed set at d(current state, b). This equals the RegionK projection (symmetry breaking removes only relabelings; emissions factor per state). Libraries, hypotheses and the library tracker from the frozen v0100_reference / v0110_reference re-implementations (ref_library, ref_hypotheses, RefTracker); RG / DLF / DLF0 / AT decisions, rules and summaries recomputed from the learner-visible trace fields; DX actions via the frozen v0110_reference.ref_lx_audit; stress counts recomputed for all 72 libraries per case. Any differing field is a mismatch.

limitations: The license design comes from seen-data diagnostics (disclosed); held-out seeds were never touched.
The family bound FB = 4 is a caller attestation: RG4 / DLF soundness is Exact only inside the declared family.

The measured transfer is a STATE-COUNT prior plus a veto: the library's hypotheses license nothing RG4 would not, except by tightening the state bound (seen: unaliased2 only). Content-level transfer is not shown.
DLF soundness outside min(n_L + 1, 4) states (n_L = 2 libraries on 4-state targets) is empirical.
The reference bounded supports are exhaustive for n <= 5; the RegionK solver UNKNOWN case is audited only as a superset.
The DX lookahead value (SAT) is not re-derived by the reference (as study-013).
The second implementation and the learners are by the same author.
Commit and ledger times are author-set.
scope_and_open: Content-level transfer (the library's hypotheses, not only its size, carrying certifying information): Open
Why SP8's certificate rule is slower than its own bounded region (RG4): Open; a candidate for a future default after its own study
